verses.1: A song for David, to be sung over the black string.
verses.2: Oh, why have you left me far from my refuge? Why have you taken away the words of my lamentation?
verses.3: I will call in the day, and you shall not answer; and in the night, nor at dawn.
verses.4: And you, holy one, sit upon the throne of Israel.
verses.5: In you we placed our trust, our ancestors placed their trust, and they were delivered.
verses.6: They cried out to you, and they were saved in you. They trusted in you, and they did not suffer.
verses.7: And I will be humiliated, and no one will be able to bring shame upon mankind.
verses.8: All those who see me will laugh at me. They’ll speak in words that provoke me.
verses.9: Let Him go to Jehovah; He will save Him, for He desires Him.
verses.10: For you, who are from the lowest ranks, I swear upon the fields of my mother.
verses.11: I have thrown you down from the mercy of my mother’s womb. You are nothing but a worthless thing.
verses.12: Do not distance yourself from me, for danger is near; there is no one who can help me.
verses.13: May they give me many gifts, O rulers of the mouth.
verses.14: A fierce lion with a loud roar attacked me.
verses.15: Like water that flows down, all my possessions were scattered apart. My heart was like a wound that bled within me.
verses.16: May my strength be like that of a wild plant; may it be strong and resilient. May it protect me from all harm and danger. May it shield me from death.
verses.17: For they treated me like dogs. A crowd of evil people surrounded me, covering my hands and feet with their hands.
verses.18: Write down all my possessions. May they be seen and feared by everyone.
verses.19: They shall divide my clothes among them, and they shall throw dust on their heads.
verses.20: And you, LORD, do not turn away from my cries for help. Please help me.
verses.21: I was saved from destruction by my only dog.
verses.22: Save me from the mouth of the lion, and from the eyes of the serpents. Answer us!
verses.23: I will tell your name to my brothers in the midst of a congregation that praises you.
verses.24: May the Lord be praised! May all the descendants of Jacob praise Him. May they be separated from all the descendants of Israel.
verses.25: For not in this way, nor by hiding his shame from him, nor by turning away from him with contempt, did Shemuel act.
verses.26: From you I will sing in the midst of a large crowd. May they take care of me, and may they protect me from their fears.
verses.27: They will eat the poor, and they will praise Jehovah. His servants will live forever in their hearts.
verses.28: Let them remember and return to the LORD. All the people of the earth shall worship you, and all the nations shall bow down before you.
verses.29: For Jehovah is the king and ruler over all nations.
verses.30: They ate and worshipped all the gods of the earth before him. All the kings of Edom bowed down before him, but their souls did not live.
verses.31: May their seed serve us, and may it be recorded for our Lord in the future.
verses.32: Let them come and declare his righteousness to the people who were born after him, for he truly did do what was right.
